title: Click Guard → Flags with a reason

steps.caption: Traffic signals
steps.narration: Every visit Click Guard records is checked as it arrives. Here's how to read the flags.

steps.caption: Blocked IPs
steps.narration: Traffic signals opens on Blocked IPs.

steps.caption: The Reason column
steps.narration: Each blocked address keeps the reason it was flagged, in the Reason column.

steps.caption: Too many visits
steps.narration: High frequency: this address made eleven visits in an hour, and sixteen in a day.

steps.caption: A headless browser
steps.narration: Bot user agent detected: this one came from a headless browser.

steps.caption: A missing user agent
steps.narration: This one is a command-line tool, and its missing user agent is a second flag.

steps.caption: A scripting tool
steps.narration: A scripting tool is named in its reason too.

steps.caption: Clicks report
steps.narration: Below, the Clicks report shows the status of every visit, flagged or not.

steps.caption: IP, device, browser, page, status
steps.narration: Each row has the IP, device, browser, operating system, page, status and time.

steps.caption: Search by IP
steps.narration: Search by IP narrows the list to one address.

steps.caption: Flagged
steps.narration: Each of its visits is marked Flagged.

steps.caption: Download CSV
steps.narration: Download CSV takes the whole report with you.

steps.caption: The rules
steps.narration: The rules are written out under Google Ads script.

steps.caption: Multi-click, bot, same device
steps.narration: More than five visits from one IP in an hour, bot user agents, and one device on different IPs.

steps.caption: Menu: Traffic signals
steps.narration: You'll find the flags under Traffic signals, in Click Guard.

youtube.title: How Click Guard flags suspicious ad clicks | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: How to read the flags in Click Guard in ConstructHUB. Blocked IPs keeps the reason for each address: too many visits in an hour or a day, a bot or headless-browser user agent, a missing user agent. The Clicks report marks every visit Flagged or Clean, with a Block button on each row.
